name: List jobs
description: Lists the jobs of the user you act for, oldest first: what ran, who started it, when, and how it ended. Without a start, the latest jobs; with one, the first created from then on. To read on, start again from the last job's created time. status and caller narrow it; fields adds other parts of each job's record, such as its input. Times are local, with their offset. A value too large to show whole, such as a long error, is shortened as covia_inspect shortens it. Read-only operations, such as reading data, leave no job, so they never appear here. Needs crud/read on the user's jobs (j).

start.description: List the first jobs created at or after this time: ISO-8601, such as 2026-11-21T09:00 (local), 2026-11-21 (local midnight) or 2026-11-21T09:00:00Z, or epoch milliseconds. Without it, the latest jobs.

limit.description: How many jobs to return, 50 by default.

status.description: Only jobs with this status, or one of these: PENDING, STARTED, PAUSED, INPUT_REQUIRED, AUTH_REQUIRED, COMPLETE, FAILED, TIMEOUT, REJECTED, CANCELLED.

caller.description: Only jobs this principal started, a DID; jobs of principals under it, such as its agents, count too.

fields.description: Other parts of each job's record to show, as subpaths, e.g. ["input", "output", "tokens/total"] or one comma-separated string. At most 16. Each appears under its subpath; one the record lacks is left out.

jobs.description: Oldest first, each with id, created and updated, and where the record has them name, op, adapter, status, caller, agentId, sessionId, parent (the job it ran inside), error and errorCode; then any fields asked for.
